title: error
description: Any of these commands with --json that was refused; nothing was written. The codes (an extensible enum: show an unknown one as it is) and their field: E_BAD_ARG (id, ref, dest, project, argv: argparse refused the arguments; a meeting sent anywhere but the daily note, todo or a local file: id), E_UNKNOWN_ID (id, ref), E_UNKNOWN_PROJECT (project), E_UNKNOWN_DEST (dest), E_DEST_OFF (dest: off, not opted in, or no executor in this version), E_OTHER_PROFILE (dest), E_NO_TEXT (text: no memo text), E_TOO_LONG (text), E_NEEDS_DEVICE (dest: it may act by itself; only the device's confirmation counts, or a one-time test proves it fills a draft), E_BUSY (ref: a send of it is running), E_ALREADY (dest: already handed or delivered there; --again sends it once more), E_UNAVAILABLE (dests: destinations.json cannot be used; none: config or events). field never echoes a value. Exit code 2 for E_BAD_ARG, E_UNKNOWN_DEST and E_UNKNOWN_PROJECT, 1 for the others. The same shape as protocol/filing/v1 error.
